title: Square Pyramid Volume Assessment
description: Show that you can identify base area and vertical height, calculate square pyramid volume, and use correct cubic units.

questions.question: A square pyramid has base side length 8 cm and vertical height 12 cm. What is its volume?
Which measurement must be used as h in V = (1/3)s^2h?
options: The side length of the square base
The slant height along a triangular face
The vertical height perpendicular to the base
questions.explanation: The h in the volume formula is the vertical height, which is perpendicular to the base.

questions.question: A square pyramid has side length 12 m and vertical height 5 m. Enter the volume as a number only.
A square pyramid has base area 81 ft^2 and vertical height 10 ft. What is its volume?
If the base side length is measured in meters, the volume of the square pyramid is measured in square meters.
questions.explanation: Volume is measured in cubic units, so the unit should be cubic meters, or m^3.

questions.question: A square pyramid has base side length 7 in, vertical height 18 in, and slant height 19.3 in. What information is needed for volume?
questions.explanation: For volume, use the square base side length and the vertical height. The slant height is not needed.

questions.question: A square pyramid has side length 4.5 cm and vertical height 6 cm. Enter the volume as a number only.
A square pyramid has volume 75 cm^3 and vertical height 9 cm. What is the area of its square base?
A student calculates V = (1/3)(10^2)(13) for a square pyramid with side length 10 cm, vertical height 8 cm, and slant height 13 cm. Explain the mistake and give the correct volume.
questions.correctAnswer: The student used the slant height, 13 cm, instead of the vertical height, 8 cm. The correct volume is (1/3)(10^2)(8) = 800/3 cm^3, or about 266.67 cm^3.
questions.explanation: Volume uses vertical height only. With base area 100 cm^2 and height 8 cm, V = (1/3)(100)(8) = 800/3 cm^3.

questions.question: A square pyramid has base side length 15 m and vertical height 12 m. Calculate the volume and include the correct unit.
